name: David Perdue
bio: A Senator from Georgia; born in Macon, Bibb County, Ga., December 10, 1949; B.S., Georgia Institute of Technology, 1972; M.S., Georgia Institute of Technology, 1976; management consultant; company executive; elected as a Republican to the United States Senate in 2014, and served from January 3, 2015 until January 3, 2021; was an unsuccessful candidate for reelection to the Senate in the January 5, 2021 general election runoff; U.S. Ambassador to China, 2025-.
